articles.title_en: The impact of firm downsizing on workers: Evidence from Ethiopia’s ready-made garment industry
articles.title_cn: 企业裁员对工人的影响：来自埃塞俄比亚成衣业的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze matched employee–employer data from Ethiopia’s largest special economic zone during a period of downsizing pressure from the COVID-19 world import demand shock. We observe substantial job displacement during the shock peak, particularly for new hires. These largely female and rural-to-urban migrants persistently “fall off the employment ladder”, remaining unemployed both within and outside the zone even after employers have recovered from the shock. We observe high levels of urban-centered food insecurity and depression symptoms during the crisis peak, regardless of employment status. Our findings highlight the importance of social protection policies within export-oriented development strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在COVID-19全球进口需求冲击导致裁员压力期间，来自埃塞俄比亚最大经济特区的匹配员工-雇主数据。我们观察到在冲击高峰期出现了大量的职位流失，尤其是新员工。这些主要是女性和农村向城市迁移的工人持续“跌落就业阶梯”，即使在雇主从冲击中恢复后，他们在特区内和外部仍然失业。我们观察到在危机高峰期，无论就业状况如何，城市中心的粮食不安全和抑郁症状都很高。我们的发现强调了在出口导向型发展战略中社会保护政策的重要性。

articles.title_en: Ideology at the Water’s Edge: Explaining Variation in Public Support for Foreign Aid
articles.title_cn: 水边意识形态：解释对外援助公众支持的差异
articles.abstract_en: To explain variation in foreign aid levels and attitudes in donor countries, past research emphasizes the importance of values related to the welfare state such as economic ideology. Scholars argue that liberals support redistribution at home in the form of a strong welfare state and redistribution abroad in the form of foreign aid. Yet, the conditions under which values related to domestic politics translate to issues of foreign policy remain undertheorized. I argue that economic ideology interacts with foreign policy orientation – individuals’ placement along the internationalist/isolationist spectrum – to shape foreign aid attitudes and outcomes. Using original data from surveys fielded in the U.S., UK, and Norway, as well as data on foreign aid spending levels, I show that the relationship between ideology and foreign aid is conditional on foreign policy orientation. The effect is driven by isolationist liberals whose support for redistribution stops at the water’s edge.
articles.abstract_cn: 为解释捐助国对外援助水平和态度的差异，过去的研究强调与福利国家相关的价值观（如经济意识形态）的重要性。学者们认为，自由派支持国内以强大福利国家形式进行的再分配，以及国外以对外援助形式进行的再分配。然而，与国内政治相关的价值观在何种条件下转化为外交政策问题仍未得到充分理论化。我认为，经济意识形态与外交政策取向——个人在国际主义/孤立主义光谱上的位置——相互作用，共同塑造对外援助态度和结果。利用在美国、英国和挪威进行的调查的原始数据，以及对外援助支出水平的数据，我表明意识形态与对外援助之间的关系以外交政策取向为条件。这种效应由孤立主义自由派驱动，他们对再分配的支持止于水边。

articles.title_en: Forecasting the prevalence of child acute malnutrition using environmental and conflict conditions as leading indicators
articles.title_cn: 利用环境和冲突条件作为领先指标预测儿童急性营养不良的患病率
articles.abstract_en: Millions of children worldwide experience acute malnutrition. Forecasts of prevalence that afford sufficient reliability, precision, and advance warning are valuable to facilitate anticipatory action capable of mitigating the extent and downsides of crises. Existing research and resources lack prediction based on statistical analysis with broad cross-national scope and a focus on identifying leading indicators. We model the prevalence of child acute malnutrition at the level of subnational geographic regions (generally first-order administrative divisions), highlighting environmental conditions (precipitation, temperature, vegetation) and lethal and non-lethal conflict activity as main predictors, alongside demographic and geographic characteristics, and involving a temporal vantage point framework that reflects requirements of practical application. Estimations are performed using the random forest machine-learning algorithm, trained on data from 36 countries across mainland Sub-Saharan Africa spanning 2003–2019, including a novel compilation of measurements of prevalence rates drawn from DHS, MICS, and SMART surveys. Our results show strong predictive performance that remains consistent with lead times extending out from one month to 12 months. All the environmental and conflict factors register as important leading indicators. The findings reinforce the potential of relying on model-based approaches to bolster the foundations for humanitarian measures that are better positioned to reduce negative repercussions of food insecurity.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球数百万儿童经历急性营养不良。具有足够可靠性、精确性和提前预警的患病率预测对于促进能够减轻危机程度和负面影响的预期行动非常有价值。现有研究和资源缺乏基于统计分析、具有广泛跨国范围并侧重于识别领先指标的预测。我们在次国家地理区域（通常为一级行政区划）层面模拟儿童急性营养不良的患病率，强调环境条件（降水、温度、植被）和致命及非致命冲突活动作为主要预测因子，同时考虑人口和地理特征，并引入反映实际应用要求的时间视角框架。使用随机森林机器学习算法进行估计，训练数据来自撒哈拉以南非洲大陆的36个国家，时间跨度为2003-2019年，包括从DHS、MICS和SMART调查中提取的患病率测量的新汇编。我们的结果显示，从一个月到12个月的提前期，预测性能强劲且保持一致。所有环境和冲突因素都被视为重要的领先指标。研究结果强化了依赖基于模型的方法来加强人道主义措施基础的潜力，这些措施能够更好地减少粮食不安全的不利影响。

articles.title_en: Bridging the gap: Mobilization of multilateral Development Banks in Infrastructure
articles.title_cn: 弥合差距：多边开发银行在基础设施中的动员作用
articles.abstract_en: We explore how Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs) can help to fill a large infrastructure financing gap in developing countries by indirectly mobilizing resources from other entities. The analysis focuses on more than 6,500 transactions in 2005–2020 to low-income developing and emerging markets from the Infrastructure Journal database. Using granular data aggregated at the country-sector level, we analyze the dynamics of flows from different actors to different infrastructure sectors and control for a wide range of fixed effects. MDB lending significantly increases the inflows from other sources. Cross-border and domestic resources are mobilized from the official and private sectors. Results exhibit country heterogeneity. Mobilization occurs in countries of all income levels though it decreases as a country’s income increases. In countries that use capital controls frequently, mobilization effects are undermined. When the 2008 global financial crisis hit, no difference in mobilization effects was found, unlike the COVID-19 pandemic when mobilization effects were weakened. Finally, we find evidence of complementarity between bilateral and multilateral financing in mobilizing resources. The findings survive a long battery of robustness checks, and no evidence of anticipation effects is found.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨多边开发银行如何通过间接动员其他实体的资源，帮助填补发展中国家巨大的基础设施融资缺口。分析聚焦于基础设施期刊数据库中2005-2020年间针对低收入发展中国家和新兴市场的超过6,500笔交易。利用按国家-部门汇总的细粒度数据，我们分析了不同行为者向不同基础设施部门的资金流动动态，并控制了广泛的固定效应。多边开发银行贷款显著增加了来自其他来源的资金流入。跨境和国内资源从官方和私营部门被动员起来。结果显示出国家异质性。动员发生在所有收入水平的国家，但随着国家收入的增加而减少。在频繁使用资本管制的国家，动员效应受到削弱。当2008年全球金融危机爆发时，未发现动员效应的差异，而COVID-19大流行期间动员效应则被削弱。最后，我们发现了双边和多边融资在资源动员中的互补性证据。这些发现经受住了大量的稳健性检验，且未发现预期效应的证据。

articles.title_en: Political trust and government performance in the time of COVID-19
articles.title_cn: COVID-19时期的政治信任与政府绩效
articles.abstract_en: Governments around the world have exhibited markedly different levels of effectiveness in handling the COVID-19 pandemic, and these variations have not been adequately explained by conventional correlates of good governance. This paper advances a co-production perspective, arguing that citizens’ predisposition to support and comply with government policies has played a crucial role in shaping countries’ pandemic performance. Analyzing a cross-country dataset that combines COVID-related cases and deaths with a new measure of political trust constructed from multiple international surveys, we show that the numbers of casualties from the pandemic are significantly lower in societies where citizens have greater trust in their governments. This relationship continues to hold even when we focus only on wealthy, democratic countries where the data quality is more reliable. Additional analyses suggest that higher political trust contributes to both greater compliance with mitigation measures by citizens and more decisive response by government. These findings underscore the importance of citizen—government collaboration for effective governance and the perils of declining political trust in advanced democracies.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界各国政府在应对COVID-19疫情时表现出了显著不同的有效性水平，而这些差异并未被常规的善治相关因素充分解释。本文提出了一种共同生产视角，认为公民支持并遵守政府政策的倾向在塑造各国疫情表现中发挥了关键作用。通过分析一个结合了COVID相关病例和死亡数据以及从多项国际调查中构建的新政治信任指标的跨国数据集，我们发现，在公民对政府信任度更高的社会中，疫情造成的伤亡人数显著更低。即使我们仅关注数据质量更可靠的富裕民主国家，这种关系依然成立。进一步的分析表明，更高的政治信任既有助于公民更遵守缓解措施，也有助于政府做出更果断的回应。这些发现强调了公民与政府合作对于有效治理的重要性，以及发达民主国家中政治信任下降的危险。

articles.title_en: Aid effectiveness and donor motives
articles.title_cn: 援助有效性与捐助者动机
articles.abstract_en: A vast literature evaluates the effectiveness of development aid, often reaching sobering conclusions. We argue that a key shortcoming of this literature is the focus on a narrow concept of effectiveness—mostly economic growth—that does not match the kind of effectiveness that aid donors actually aim at. To determine actual donor motives, we first survey the literature on aid allocation and identify a large set of motives that is common to many donors. We then employ this set of donor motives for compiling a survey of the aid effectiveness literature by donor motive. The literature shows that while aid has a moderate effect on economic development at best, it seems effective in achieving many of the other effects primarily intended by aid donors. We conclude by speculating that future research on aid effectiveness will be more likely to identify significant effects of aid when taking donor motives into account.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献评估发展援助的有效性，往往得出令人清醒的结论。我们认为，这一文献的一个关键缺陷在于其关注的是狭义的有效性概念——主要是经济增长——这与援助捐助者实际追求的有效性并不匹配。为了确定捐助者的真实动机，我们首先调查了关于援助分配的文献，并识别出许多捐助者共有的广泛动机。然后，我们利用这一组捐助者动机，按捐助者动机对援助有效性文献进行综述。文献表明，虽然援助对经济发展的影响至多中等，但在实现援助捐助者主要意图的许多其他效果方面似乎有效。我们最后推测，未来关于援助有效性的研究在考虑捐助者动机时，更有可能识别出援助的显著效果。

articles.title_en: State and NGO coproduction of health care in the Gran Chaco
articles.title_cn: 国家与非政府组织在大查科地区的医疗保健共同生产
articles.abstract_en: The collaboration between state and civil society in the delivery of public services is paramount to sustainable and participatory development in rural areas with marginalized populations. Previous research identified complementarity and embeddedness as two essential features of successful coproduction. However, most of the literature on coproduction studies users and providers who share the same language and culture, even if power asymmetries are high. We combine the literatures on non-state social welfare provision and on coproduction to analyze a collaboration between states and non-governmental organizations (NGOs) in multicultural and multilingual contexts. In such contexts, we argue, embeddedness requires not only language interpreters but also intercultural policies and training, without which the benefits of coproduction are lost in translation.Our study is based on a recent collaboration between the states of Argentina, Bolivia, and Paraguay and two health care NGOs that provide prenatal care to women in the Gran Chaco. In this region, a large portion of the population is Indigenous and maternal and infant mortality are high. Based on participant observation and in-depth interviews, combined with observational data, we analyze the experiences of public health care providers and NGO doctors involved in the intervention. We evaluate if there is complementarity between the state and the NGOs regarding access to preventive health care, diagnosis and treatment, and human resources in the health sector. Finally, we analyze whether state or NGO actors are embedded in local civil society or Indigenous communities. We find that this medical intervention significantly improves access to and delivery of health care to pregnant women, and promotes attention to neglected diseases such as Chagas. It also improves local human resources in the health sector. Despite these benefits, it lacks an intercultural approach to health care, limiting its potential, but also opening new opportunities for future research and practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 国家与公民社会在公共服务提供中的合作对于边缘化人群居住的农村地区的可持续和参与式发展至关重要。以往的研究将互补性和嵌入性视为成功共同生产的两个基本特征。然而，大多数关于共同生产的文献研究的是共享相同语言和文化的使用者和提供者，即使权力不对称程度很高。我们将非国家社会福利提供和共同生产的文献结合起来，分析在多元文化和多语言背景下国家与非政府组织（NGOs）之间的合作。我们认为，在这种背景下，嵌入性不仅需要语言翻译，还需要跨文化政策和培训，否则共同生产的益处会在翻译中丢失。我们的研究基于阿根廷、玻利维亚和巴拉圭国家与两个为大查科地区妇女提供产前保健的非政府组织之间的近期合作。在该地区，大部分人口是原住民，孕产妇和婴儿死亡率很高。基于参与观察和深度访谈，结合观察数据，我们分析了参与干预的公共卫生保健提供者和非政府组织医生的经验。我们评估国家与非政府组织在预防性保健、诊断和治疗以及卫生部门人力资源方面是否存在互补性。最后，我们分析国家或非政府组织行为者是否嵌入当地公民社会或原住民社区。我们发现，这项医疗干预显著改善了孕妇获得和接受医疗保健的机会，并促进了对如恰加斯病等被忽视疾病的关注。它还改善了当地卫生部门的人力资源。尽管有这些益处，它缺乏跨文化的医疗保健方法，限制了其潜力，但也为未来的研究和实践开辟了新的机会。

articles.title_en: From absences to emergences: Foregrounding traditional and Indigenous climate change adaptation knowledges and practices from Fiji, Vietnam and the Philippines
articles.title_cn: 从缺席到显现：突出斐济、越南和菲律宾的传统与土著气候变化适应知识与实践
articles.abstract_en: The differential impacts of climate change have highlighted the need to implement fit-for-purpose interventions that are reflective of the needs of vulnerable communities. However, adaptation projects tend to favour technocratic, market-driven, and Eurocentric approaches that inadvertently disregard the place-based and contextual adaptation strategies of many communities in the Global South. The paper aims to decolonise climate change adaptation guided by the critical tenets of ‘Decolonising Climate Adaptation Scholarship’ (DCAS). It presents empirical case studies from Fiji, Vietnam, and the Philippines and reveals the different ways that Indigenous and local knowledge (ILK) and strategies are devalued and suppressed by modernist and developmentalist approaches to climate adaptation. The paper then foregrounds some of the adaptive techniques that resist and remain, or have been re-worked in hybrid ways with ILK. Ultimately, this paper combats the delegitimisation of ILK by mainstream climate change adaptation scholarship and highlights the need for awareness and openness to other forms of knowing and being.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化的差异性影响凸显了实施适合目标的干预措施的必要性，这些措施应反映脆弱社区的需求。然而，适应项目往往倾向于技术官僚、市场驱动和欧洲中心主义的方法，无意中忽视了全球南方许多社区基于地方和情境的适应策略。本文旨在以“去殖民化气候适应学术”（DCAS）的关键原则为指导，对气候变化适应进行去殖民化。文章呈现了来自斐济、越南和菲律宾的实证案例研究，揭示了土著和地方知识（ILK）及策略被现代主义和发展主义的气候适应方法贬低和压制的不同方式。随后，文章突出了那些抵抗并留存下来，或已与ILK以混合方式重新改造的适应技术。最终，本文对抗主流气候变化适应学术对ILK的非法化，并强调对其他认知和存在形式的意识与开放性的必要性。

articles.title_en: Scaling-up sustainable commodity governance through jurisdictional initiatives: Political pathways to sector transformation in the Indonesian palm oil sector?
articles.title_cn: 通过管辖区倡议扩大可持续商品治理规模：印度尼西亚棕榈油行业部门转型的政治路径？
articles.abstract_en: Voluntary systems of sustainable commodity governance have come under intensified criticism for failing to catalyse transformative change beyond directly regulated supply chains. In response, there has been a surge of efforts to ‘scale-up’ sustainability impacts through governance interventions at landscape and jurisdictional scales. While these ambitious, scaled-up approaches are attracting significant interest, such approaches demand substantial changes to established repertoires of policy interventions and associated understandings of the pathways through which these contribute to sustainability outcomes. Drawing theoretical insights from scholarship on multi-stakeholder sustainability governance together with findings from a qualitative study of jurisdictional governance experiments in the Indonesian palm oil sector, this paper explores how emerging jurisdictional initiatives are promoting change pathways towards more sustainable commodity production, and how the political, environmental governance and economic contexts in which these interventions are implemented influence these pathways. Analysis shows that by integrating a distinctive mix of market and policy-driven interventions, jurisdictional approaches are contributing to three core pathways of change, centred respectively on network and coalition-building, collaborative governance, and resource mobilisation. However, which of these pathways are most influential, how interventions are sequenced and operationalised, and how the pathways interact in shaping change is highly sensitive to varied subnational implementation contexts, with important implications for the impact and resilience of jurisdictional programs. These findings highlight the need for jurisdictional policy interventions to respond flexibly to contextually-variable configurations of actor interests, coalitions and power relations within contested multi-scalar processes of sustainable commodity governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 自愿性可持续商品治理体系因未能催化直接监管供应链之外的变革性变化而受到强烈批评。为此，通过景观和管辖区尺度的治理干预来“扩大”可持续性影响的努力激增。尽管这些雄心勃勃的扩大化方法引起了广泛关注，但此类方法要求对既定的政策干预手段及其对可持续性结果贡献路径的相关理解进行重大改变。本文借鉴多利益相关方可持续性治理研究的理论见解，以及对印度尼西亚棕榈油行业管辖区治理实验的定性研究结果，探讨新兴的管辖区倡议如何促进向更可持续商品生产的变革路径，以及这些干预措施实施所处的政治、环境治理和经济背景如何影响这些路径。分析表明，通过整合市场和政策驱动干预措施的独特组合，管辖区方法正在促进三个核心变革路径，分别侧重于网络和联盟建设、协作治理以及资源动员。然而，这些路径中哪些最具影响力、干预措施如何排序和实施，以及这些路径在塑造变革中如何相互作用，对不同的次国家级实施背景高度敏感，这对管辖区项目的影响和韧性具有重要意义。这些发现强调，管辖区政策干预需要灵活应对可持续商品治理竞争性多尺度进程中行为者利益、联盟和权力关系的背景性变化配置。

articles.title_en: Capital Markets, Temporary Migration and Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 资本市场、临时迁移与创业：来自孟加拉国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines international temporary migration as an intermediary step among aspiring entrepreneurs to accumulate the needed capital when they face credit constraints at home. The analysis is based on a representative dataset of lifetime employment histories of return migrants from Bangladesh. After establishing the credit constraints that potential entrepreneurs face, the paper shows that non-agricultural self-employment rates are significantly higher among returning migrants — over half versus around 20% of non-migrants. Most migrants transition into self-employment by using their savings from abroad as the main source of financing. The paper then offers, for the first time, a detailed account of the financial costs and benefits of international migration. Our findings suggest that temporary migration can contribute to structural transformation of lower-income countries by enabling credit-constrained workers to enter into non-agricultural entrepreneurship.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国际临时迁移作为有抱负的企业家在面临国内信贷约束时积累所需资本的一个中间步骤。分析基于孟加拉国返乡移民终身就业历史的代表性数据集。在确定了潜在企业家面临的信贷约束后，本文表明，返乡移民中的非农业自雇率显著更高——超过一半，而非移民约为20%。大多数移民通过使用他们在国外的储蓄作为主要融资来源过渡到自雇。本文随后首次详细阐述了国际迁移的财务成本和收益。我们的研究结果表明，临时迁移可以通过使受信贷约束的工人进入非农业创业，从而促进低收入国家的结构转型。

articles.title_en: Keeping communal peace in the shadow of civil war: A natural experiment from Côte d’Ivoire
articles.title_cn: 在内战阴影下维持社区和平：来自科特迪瓦的一项自然实验
articles.abstract_en: Violent communal conflicts between identity-based groups are a severe threat to human security and development. While most communal conflicts take place in civil war-affected countries, communal conflict is not an inevitable byproduct of civil war. What explains communal peace in civil war? Existing research tends to overlook interlinkages between communal conflict and civil war, meaning that knowledge on how armed groups exacerbate or mitigate communal conflicts is limited. Combining insights from research on communal conflict and non-state armed groups, this study proposes that communal conflicts are less severe in areas controlled by legitimacy-seeking armed groups that seek acceptance for its political authority and right to rule from domestic and international audiences. Legitimacy-seeking armed groups have greater incentives to develop institutions and practices that prevent both communal conflict onset and escalation, which helps keep communal peace. The study examines the argument through a natural experiment in western Côte d’Ivoire, where more legitimacy-seeking and more legitimacy-indifferent armed groups came to control proximate and highly comparable communities because of an arbitrary ceasefire line. Using process-tracing to analyze unique interview and archival sources, the study demonstrates that communal conflicts were far deadlier in areas controlled by the more legitimacy-indifferent militias than in areas controlled by the more legitimacy-seeking Forces Nouvelles rebel group. These findings highlight that armed groups can be both agents of wartime disorder and order, and contribute new insights on communal peace in the shadow of civil war.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于身份群体的暴力社区冲突是对人类安全与发展的严重威胁。尽管大多数社区冲突发生在受内战影响的国家，但社区冲突并非内战的必然副产品。是什么解释了内战中的社区和平？现有研究往往忽视社区冲突与内战之间的相互联系，这意味着关于武装团体如何加剧或缓解社区冲突的知识有限。结合社区冲突和非国家武装团体研究的见解，本研究提出，在寻求合法性的武装团体控制的地区，社区冲突的严重程度较低，这些团体寻求国内和国际受众对其政治权威和统治权的接受。寻求合法性的武装团体有更大的动机发展制度和实践，以防止社区冲突的发生和升级，这有助于维持社区和平。该研究通过科特迪瓦西部的一项自然实验来检验这一论点，在那里，由于一条任意停火线，更寻求合法性和更不关心合法性的武装团体控制了邻近且高度可比的社区。通过过程追踪分析独特的访谈和档案资料，研究表明，在更不关心合法性的民兵控制的地区，社区冲突的致命性远高于更寻求合法性的新生力量反叛团体控制的地区。这些发现强调，武装团体既可以是战时混乱的代理人，也可以是秩序的代理人，并为内战阴影下的社区和平提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Do conditional cash transfers create resilience against poverty? Long-run evidence from Jamaica
articles.title_cn: 有条件现金转移支付能否增强抵御贫困的能力？来自牙买加的长期证据
articles.abstract_en: Conditional Cash Transfer programs (CCT) have become the prominent component of social assistance programs in many developing countries. A major objective of CCT programs is breaking the cycle of intergenerational poverty and building a population resilient to adverse shocks that may push a person into poverty. The literature to date has not provided conclusive evidence for the long-run impact of CCT programs on beneficiaries’ resilience against poverty. To fill this gap, I exploit the age-based eligibility thresholds and regional variation in the proportion of persons receiving benefits from the Jamaican CCT program to identify its long-run impact on resilience against poverty. I find that child beneficiaries of the program are up to 8.4 percentage points more resilient against poverty when they become adults than they would have been in the absence of the program. Furthermore, these benefits are only evident in females, and are realized after beneficiaries are in their early 20′s. Overall, this study provides further justification for the expansion of CCTs or similar programs targeting children living in less-developed countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 有条件现金转移支付项目（CCT）已成为许多发展中国家社会救助项目的重要组成部分。CCT项目的一个主要目标是打破代际贫困循环，并建立能够抵御可能将人推向贫困的不利冲击的人口韧性。迄今为止，文献尚未为CCT项目对受益者抵御贫困能力的长期影响提供确凿证据。为填补这一空白，我利用基于年龄的资格门槛和牙买加CCT项目受益者比例的地区差异，来识别其对抵御贫困能力的长期影响。我发现，与没有该项目的情况相比，该项目的儿童受益者在成年后抵御贫困的能力提高了最多8.4个百分点。此外，这些益处仅在女性中显现，并在受益者进入20岁出头后实现。总体而言，本研究为扩大针对欠发达国家儿童的CCT或类似项目提供了进一步的理由。

articles.title_en: Lasting scars: The long-term effects of school closures on earnings
articles.title_cn: 持久的伤痕：学校停课对收入的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of education disruptions on earnings in the long term using a natural experiment. In particular, we estimate the effects of school closures due to the 1999 NATO bombing of Serbia on earnings 20 years later. Our results point to substantial and lasting effects: those in first grade at the time of the shock earn about 7–9 percent less 20 years after the shock than unaffected cohorts just younger than them. Impacts are larger for those in the bottom half of the income distribution. We find that selection into lower-paying sectors (possibly due to higher risk aversion) explains about 15 percent of the overall effect. However, the negative effect of education disruption persists despite affected cohorts staying in school longer, being more likely to work for the public sector and having open-ended contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项自然实验考察教育中断对收入的长期影响。具体而言，我们估算了因1999年北约轰炸塞尔维亚导致的学校停课对20年后收入的影响。我们的结果显示出显著且持久的影响：在冲击发生时处于一年级的学生，在冲击发生20年后的收入比仅比他们年轻的未受影响队列低约7-9%。对于收入分配下半部分的人群，影响更大。我们发现，选择进入低薪行业（可能由于更高的风险厌恶）解释了总体效应的约15%。然而，尽管受影响的队列在校时间更长、更可能就职于公共部门并拥有无固定期限合同，教育中断的负面影响仍然持续存在。

articles.title_en: Is the conventional wisdom on resource taxation correct? Mining evidence from African countries' tax legislations
articles.abstract_en: Our study reexamines the link between country risk and government take, following research by Adebayo et al. (2021). Our approach complements theirs. We study the mining tax policy choices in an environment of uncertainty and risk country for twenty-one African gold-producing countries. We calculate a de jure government take based on the complete application of laws and regulations for three “representative mines”. Our results reconcile Adebayo et al.'s theoretical model with empirical results. Higher country risk is associated with lower de jure government take. We also show a complex nonlinear relationship between country risk and de jure government take. Finally, our results suggest that stronger political institutions “capture” a lower de jure government take. The coefficient of the interaction term suggests that as the political regime becomes more democratic, the marginal effect of country risk on de jure government revenue becomes increasingly less adverse up to a specific threshold, beyond which it turns positive. We then introduce each political component of country risk and its interaction term to track transmission channels.

articles.title_en: Changes in adult well-being and economic inequalities: An exploratory observational longitudinal study (2002–2010) of micro-level trends among Tsimane’, a small-scale rural society of Indigenous People in the Bolivian Amazon
articles.title_cn: 成人福祉与经济不平等的变化：一项关于玻利维亚亚马逊土著小型农村社会Tsimane’微观趋势的探索性观察纵向研究（2002-2010）
articles.abstract_en: Knowing what happens over time to the lifeways of people in contemporary small-scale non-industrial societies of the rural Global South matters because it helps assess changes in the quality of life of underrepresented groups. It has been hard to answer the question because longitudinal information is rarely collected in such settings. A longitudinal dataset of nine years (2002–2010) from a horticultural-foraging society of Indigenous People in the Bolivian Amazon (Tsimane’) is used for an exploratory analysis of micro-level trends in indicators of well-being and economic inequalities. We selected 13 Tsimane’ villages (from ∼ 100) that varied in proximity to town and surveyed all households in each village. ∼ 240 households were followed yearly to estimate trends of 21 outcomes (e.g., income, sociality, macronutrients). For each economic outcome, annual and all-years-combined Gini coefficients were estimated for the entire sample across the 13 villages. We show a rise in total asset wealth, a change in asset composition (less traditional wealth, more commercial wealth), higher monetary value of foods eaten, and better-perceived health, but a decline in caloric and protein consumption and no marked gender differences in objective or hedonic measures of well-being. Economic inequalities were non-trivial and showed no marked trend but varied between years; asset inequality varied less than income inequality. We document the value of longitudinal, locally grounded indexes of well-being to obtain a granular view of micro-level changes in well-being and the possible use of inequality in the consumption of calories and macronutrients as a valid proxy for income inequality in rural areas of the Global South with tenuous links to the market economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 了解当代全球南方农村非工业化小型社会中人们生活方式随时间的变化，有助于评估代表性不足群体生活质量的改变。由于此类环境中很少收集纵向数据，回答这一问题一直很困难。利用来自玻利维亚亚马逊土著园艺-采集社会（Tsimane’）的九年纵向数据集（2002-2010），对福祉和经济不平等的微观趋势指标进行探索性分析。我们选取了13个Tsimane’村庄（来自约100个），这些村庄与城镇的距离各异，并对每个村庄的所有家庭进行了调查。约240户家庭每年被追踪，以估计21项结果（如收入、社交性、宏量营养素）的趋势。对于每个经济结果，估计了全部样本在13个村庄中的年度和所有年份合并的基尼系数。我们显示，总资产财富增加，资产构成发生变化（传统财富减少，商业财富增加），所食食物的货币价值提高，感知健康改善，但热量和蛋白质消费下降，客观或享乐福祉指标没有显著的性别差异。经济不平等不容忽视，但没有显著趋势，且在不同年份间有所变化；资产不平等的变化小于收入不平等。我们记录了纵向、本地化的福祉指数的价值，以获得微观层面福祉变化的细致视图，以及在市场联系薄弱的全球南方农村地区，热量和宏量营养素消费不平等可能作为收入不平等的有效代理指标。

articles.title_en: Exposure to large-scale farms increases smallholders’ competitive behavior and closes the gender gap
articles.title_cn: 接触大型农场增强小农户的竞争行为并缩小性别差距
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how exposure to large-scale farms affects smallholders’ competitive behavior. Based on lab-in-the-field experimental measures covering more than 900 smallholders and 400 children in Zambia, we find that smallholders who are traditionally dependent on subsistence agriculture behave more competitively when they are located close to large-scale farms. This effect is especially pronounced for female smallholders and closes the gender gap associated with competitiveness. This result replicates for their children. We identify female employment and shifting intra-household tasks as a possible mechanism. Our results provide new insights for understanding how changes in societal arrangements like market integration influence economic behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了接触大型农场如何影响小农户的竞争行为。基于在赞比亚对超过900名小农户和400名儿童进行的实验室实地实验测量，我们发现，传统上依赖自给农业的小农户在靠近大型农场时表现出更强的竞争行为。这一效应在女性小农户中尤为显著，并缩小了与竞争性相关的性别差距。这一结果在其子女中得到了复制。我们确定了女性就业和家庭内部任务的转移作为可能的机制。我们的结果为理解市场整合等社会安排的变迁如何影响经济行为提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the Income Inequality-Crime Puzzle
articles.title_cn: 重新审视收入不平等与犯罪之谜
articles.abstract_en: The economics literature generally supports a positive theoretical link between income inequality and crime. However, despite this consensus, empirical evidence has struggled to yield definitive conclusions. To address this puzzle, I conducted a meta-analysis based on 1,341 estimates drawn from 43 studies in economics journals. The findings indicate a statistically significant but economically insignificant true effect of inequality on crime, ranging between 0.007 and 0.123 using UWLS FAT-PET and advanced methods. In essence, if there is an impact of inequality on crime, it is, at best, minimal. Additionally, there is some limited evidence suggesting positive publication bias. Results from Bayesian model averaging reveal that inequality does not affect exclusively property crime, as predicted by the rational choice models. Moreover, this analysis shows that inequality measures which are sensitive to changes in income at the middle and top of the distribution are associated with higher coefficients. The study also underscores the biases arising from the exclusion of relevant variables. The implications of this research suggest that inequality may not be the primary motivator for criminal behaviour, with other factors potentially playing more significant roles. Lastly, if inequality does affect crime, it might do so in different ways than those discussed by the majority of the existing empirical studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学文献普遍支持收入不平等与犯罪之间存在正向的理论联系。然而，尽管存在这一共识，实证证据却难以得出明确结论。为解决这一难题，我基于经济学期刊中43项研究提供的1,341个估计值进行了元分析。研究结果表明，不平等对犯罪的真实效应在统计上显著但在经济上不显著，使用UWLS FAT-PET和先进方法得出的范围在0.007至0.123之间。本质上，如果不平等对犯罪有影响，其影响至多也是微乎其微。此外，有有限证据表明存在正向的发表偏倚。贝叶斯模型平均的结果显示，不平等并非如理性选择模型所预测的那样仅影响财产犯罪。此外，该分析表明，对收入分配中端和顶端收入变化敏感的不平等度量与更高的系数相关。研究还强调了遗漏相关变量所产生的偏倚。本研究的启示表明，不平等可能不是犯罪行为的主要动机，其他因素可能发挥更重要的作用。最后，如果不平等确实影响犯罪，其影响方式可能与大多数现有实证研究所讨论的不同。

articles.title_en: Spatial education inequality for attainment indicators in sub-saharan Africa and spillovers effects
articles.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲教育成就指标的空间不平等与溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: Space plays a prominent role on educational inequalities. Spatially proximate communities are likely to behave and perform similarly than spatially distant communities because educational processes, demand and supply factors, are often location specific within a country, with educational outcomes and educational inequalities being spatially dependent. Yet, studies on monitoring education inequalities linked to SDG4 indicators have ignored the crucial role of spatial dependence and failed to look at granular educational inequality beyond standard urban/rural and country’s regions classifications. In this paper, we account for social dependence among communities to assess spatial education inequalities for the sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) region by relying on the geo-localisation of 16,000 communities for 29 countries based on DHS surveys. We use an array of education indicators across the lifecourse (completion rates from primary to tertiary) and measures of attainment and for risk of dropout (primary over-age), allowing us to measure how spatial dependence of educational outcomes changes at varying levels of education. We employ mapping, spatial correlations statistics and spatial regression models to account for the spatial dependence and endogeneity among communities’ educational performance shaped by their contextual factors and to derive education spillovers. Our study’s findings for the SSA region can be grouped as: space matters for communities educational performance, even after accounting for various community-level observables; educational spatial dependence operates more powerfully in marginalised communities; and that space matters indirectly through contextual factors of nearby communities in the form of educational externalities. The overreaching implication of our study is that commonly used geographical categories of rural–urban, or regions within countries are not adequate to address educational challenges and studies should place more emphasis on GIS-based analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 空间在教育不平等中扮演着重要角色。空间上邻近的社区在行为和表现上可能比空间上相距较远的社区更为相似，因为教育过程、需求和供给因素往往在一个国家内具有地点特定性，教育成果和教育不平等具有空间依赖性。然而，关于监测与SDG4指标相关的教育不平等的研究忽视了空间依赖的关键作用，并且未能在标准的城乡和国家地区分类之外考察细粒度的教育不平等。在本文中，我们考虑社区间的社会依赖性，基于DHS调查中29个国家的16,000个社区的地理位置，评估撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）地区的空间教育不平等。我们使用一系列贯穿生命历程的教育指标（从小学到高等教育的完成率）、成就衡量指标以及辍学风险指标（小学超龄），从而衡量教育成果的空间依赖性在不同教育水平上的变化。我们采用绘图、空间相关统计和空间回归模型来考虑社区教育表现受其背景因素影响的空间依赖性和内生性，并推导教育溢出效应。我们对SSA地区的研究发现可归纳为：即使在考虑了各种社区层面的可观测因素后，空间对社区教育表现仍然重要；教育空间依赖性在边缘化社区中作用更强；空间通过邻近社区的背景因素以教育外部性的形式间接产生影响。我们研究的总体含义是，常用的城乡或国家内部地区的地理分类不足以解决教育挑战，研究应更加重视基于GIS的分析。

articles.title_en: The economic impact of CGIAR-related crop technologies on agricultural productivity in developing countries, 1961–2020
articles.title_cn: CGIAR相关作物技术对发展中国家农业生产力的经济影响，1961-2020年
articles.abstract_en: The international agricultural research centers that comprise the CGIAR got their start in the 1960s. They soon made major contributions to crop improvement in developing countries, particular in rice and wheat in Asia. Today, farmers can acquire new technologies from many sources, and evidence of whether the CGIAR continues to play an important role in crop improvement has become dated. This paper brings together an expanded set of evidence on the diffusion and productivity impact of CGIAR crop research through 2020, and breaks out these impacts by crop, region, and over time. By 2016–2020, CGIAR-related crop technologies had been adopted on at least 221 million hectares across Asia, Africa and Latin America, generating economic welfare gains of $47 billion annually. In the 2010s, technology adoption and welfare impacts were increasing by about $600 million annually, almost as much as in the 1990s. In the early days of the “Green Revolution,” these welfare impacts were largely confined to rice and wheat in Asia, but in recent decades have grown to include a larger range of crops and geographies, notably cassava and maize in Sub-Saharan Africa. Although improved crop varieties have been the main technology through which CGIAR crop centers have achieved these impacts, CGIAR-related integrated pest management and natural resource management technologies have also made significant contributions to crop productivity. In addition to raising farm income, productivity gains in staple crops have lowered food prices, thereby benefitting the whole population. This is a key reason why agricultural productivity growth, and food crop productivity growth in particular, has had greater impacts on poverty reduction in low-income countries than comparable productivity growth in other sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 组成CGIAR的国际农业研究中心始于1960年。它们很快就在发展中国家的作物改良方面做出了重大贡献，尤其是在亚洲的水稻和小麦方面。如今，农民可以从许多来源获得新技术，而关于CGIAR是否继续在作物改良中发挥重要作用的证据已经过时。本文汇集了截至2020年关于CGIAR作物研究扩散和生产力影响的扩展证据集，并按作物、地区和时期细分这些影响。到2016-2020年，CGIAR相关的作物技术已在亚洲、非洲和拉丁美洲至少221亿公顷的土地上被采用，每年产生47亿美元的经济福利收益。在2010年，技术采用和福利影响每年增加约600亿美元，几乎与1990年一样多。在“绿色革命”早期，这些福利影响主要局限于亚洲的水稻和小麦，但近几十年来已扩大到包括更多种类的作物和地区，特别是撒哈拉以南非洲的木薯和玉米。尽管改良作物品种是CGIAR作物中心实现这些影响的主要技术，但CGIAR相关的综合病虫害管理和自然资源管理技术也对作物生产力做出了重要贡献。除了提高农业收入外，主粮作物的生产力提高还降低了食品价格，从而使全体人口受益。这是农业生产力增长，特别是粮食作物生产力增长，对低收入国家减贫的影响大于其他部门可比生产力增长的关键原因。

articles.title_en: Can information intervention improve dietary quality? Evidence from a randomized controlled trial in rural China
articles.title_cn: 信息干预能否改善膳食质量？来自中国农村随机对照试验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Nutrition education interventions are widely used globally but with mixed results. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to examine the effects of a nutrition education and a precise message (awareness-raising) intervention on nutrition knowledge and dietary quality of households in rural China. Treatment groups first received a lecture on the Chinese Food Guide Pagoda, and then all family members were measured for height and weight and informed of household overweight status. We analyzed 358 households before and after this intervention. Participants in the treatment group increased their dietary knowledge by 6% and improved their dietary quality by 8% after the intervention. The intervention effects were stronger for households with more than 25% and 50% of overweight people. Our study provides evidence that an intervention based on general nutrition information and delivery of a precise message to households can effectively improve dietary quality. Our findings inform the food policy debate on whether nutrition information interventions are effective. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to evaluate the effectiveness of a nutrition information intervention to improve dietary quality in rural China.
articles.abstract_cn: 营养教育干预在全球广泛使用，但效果不一。我们进行了一项随机对照试验，以检验营养教育和精准信息（提高意识）干预对中国农村家庭营养知识和膳食质量的影响。治疗组首先接受关于中国膳食指南宝塔的讲座，然后测量所有家庭成员的身高和体重，并告知家庭超重状况。我们在干预前后分析了358户家庭。干预后，治疗组参与者的膳食知识提高了6%，膳食质量提高了8%。对于超重人数超过25%和50%的家庭，干预效果更强。我们的研究提供证据表明，基于一般营养信息和向家庭传递精准信息的干预可以有效改善膳食质量。我们的研究结果为关于营养信息干预是否有效的食品政策辩论提供了信息。此外，据我们所知，这是第一项评估营养信息干预改善中国农村膳食质量有效性的研究。

articles.title_en: Status inequality and public goods
articles.title_cn: 地位不平等与公共品
articles.abstract_en: The association between social diversity and state-provided public goods is a central political economy problem. This paper highlights how status inequality is a distinct political channel when diverse groups are spatially segregated. Social status impacts citizens’ ability to petition the state successfully and modulates state favoritism or discrimination. We use data from nearly 600,000 Indian villages to show that caste-based status inequality modifies the effect of diversity on local public goods politics. Diversity only negatively impacts local public goods in units where lower-caste groups are numerically preponderant. Such diversity deficit is further amplified when higher-caste groups numerically dominate larger administrative units and lower-caste groups are segregated.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会多样性与国家提供的公共品之间的关联是一个核心的政治经济学问题。本文强调，当不同群体在空间上隔离时，地位不平等是一个独特的政治渠道。社会地位影响公民成功向国家请愿的能力，并调节国家的偏袒或歧视。我们利用来自近600,000个印度村庄的数据表明，基于种姓的地位不平等改变了多样性对地方公共品政治的影响。多样性仅在低种姓群体在数量上占优势的单位中对地方公共品产生负面影响。当高种姓群体在更大的行政单位中数量上占主导地位且低种姓群体被隔离时，这种多样性赤字进一步加剧。

articles.title_en: How peace saves lives: Evidence from Colombia
articles.title_cn: 和平如何拯救生命：来自哥伦比亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: The victimization of civilians and combatants during internal conflicts causes large socioeconomic costs. Unfortunately, it is not clear whether peace negotiations can significantly reduce this burden. One key reason is the lingering presence of antipersonnel landmines, which are hidden underground and remain active for decades. Looking at the recent experience of Colombia, we quantify the number of lives saved by the reduction of landmine accidents and study the institutional conditions under which peace agreements can significantly reduce landmine victimization. Our findings highlight the importance of: reduced counterinsurgency campaigns, post-conflict information sharing, comprehensive humanitarian mine clearance, and mine risk management campaigns.
articles.abstract_cn: 内部冲突期间平民和战斗人员受害化造成巨大的社会经济成本。不幸的是，尚不清楚和平谈判能否显著减轻这一负担。一个关键原因是杀伤人员地雷的持续存在，它们隐藏在地下，数十年后仍然有效。基于哥伦比亚的近期经验，我们量化了因地雷事故减少而拯救的生命数量，并研究了和平协议在何种制度条件下能够显著减少地雷受害化。我们的发现强调了以下方面的重要性：减少反叛乱行动、冲突后信息共享、全面的人道主义排雷以及地雷风险管理运动。

articles.title_en: United Nations peacekeeping operations and multilateral foreign aid: Credibility of good governance
articles.title_cn: 联合国维和行动与多边对外援助：良好治理的可信度
articles.abstract_en: Does hosting UN Peacekeeping Operations (UN PKOs) increase multilateral foreign aid inflows into civil war-affected countries? Under what conditions do UN PKOs make multilateral foreign aid effective, enhancing governance quality? Multilateral foreign aid agencies increasingly focus on good governance as an allocation criterion. However, multilateral aid assistance faces dilemmas when allocating aid since it undermines the credibility of government commitments to good governance. This study argues that UN PKOs mitigate such uncertainty by initiating democratization, capacity-building, and political participation while mitigating political violence, thereby increasing the multilateral aid inflows. In missions involving these initiations, multilateral aid effectively enhances governance quality. These arguments are tested using a sample of countries that have experienced civil wars between 1991 and 2009. The findings suggest that UN PKOs increase the multilateral aid inflows. Moreover, increasing multilateral aid is more effective in improving the governance quality when missions have capacity-building or electoral tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: 接纳联合国维和行动（UN PKOs）是否会增加内战受影响国家的多边对外援助流入？在何种条件下，联合国维和行动使多边对外援助有效，提升治理质量？多边对外援助机构日益将良好治理作为分配标准。然而，多边援助在分配援助时面临困境，因为它削弱了政府对良好治理承诺的可信度。本研究认为，联合国维和行动通过启动民主化、能力建设和政治参与，同时减少政治暴力，从而缓解这种不确定性，进而增加多边援助流入。在涉及这些启动的任务中，多边援助有效提升治理质量。这些论点使用1991年至2009年间经历过内战的国家样本进行检验。研究结果表明，联合国维和行动增加了多边援助流入。此外，当任务具有能力建设或选举任务时，增加多边援助在改善治理质量方面更为有效。

articles.title_en: Does early nutrition predict cognitive skills during later childhood? Evidence from two developing countries
articles.title_cn: 早期营养能否预测童年后期的认知技能？来自两个发展中国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: The existing evidence linking early undernutrition to educational outcomes in developing countries is largely focused on assessing its impacts on grade attainment and achievement test scores, with limited evidence on the foundational cognitive skills required to perform well at school. We use unique data collected in Ethiopia and Peru as part of the Young Lives Study to investigate the relationship between early undernutrition and four foundational cognitive skills measured later in childhood, the first two of which measure executive functioning: working memory, inhibitory control, long-term memory, and implicit learning. We exploit the rich longitudinal data available to control for potential confounders at the household and individual level and for time-invariant community characteristics. We also take advantage of the availability of data for paired-siblings to obtain household fixed-effects estimates. In the latter specification, we find robust evidence that stunting at ∼age 5 is negatively related with executive functions measured years later, predicting reductions in working memory and inhibitory control by 12.6 % and 5.8 % of a standard deviation. Although the main cohort of Young Lives was around 12 years old when executive functions were measured, complementary results and analysis of the data available for the younger siblings suggest that the impact of stunting on executive functions—specifically, on working memory—starts at an earlier age. Our results shed light on the mechanisms that explain the relationship between early nutrition and school achievement tests suggesting that good nutrition is an important determinant of children’s learning capacities.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有关于发展中国家早期营养不良与教育成果之间联系的证据，主要集中在评估其对年级达标和学业成绩测试的影响，而对于在学校表现良好所需的基础认知技能的证据有限。我们利用作为“青年生活研究”一部分在埃塞俄比亚和秘鲁收集的独特数据，调查早期营养不良与童年后期测量的四种基础认知技能之间的关系，其中前两种衡量执行功能：工作记忆、抑制控制、长期记忆和内隐学习。我们利用丰富的纵向数据来控制家庭和个人层面的潜在混杂因素以及不随时间变化的社区特征。我们还利用配对兄弟姐妹的数据获得家庭固定效应估计。在后一种设定中，我们发现强有力的证据表明，约5岁时的发育迟缓与数年后测量的执行功能负相关，预测工作记忆和抑制控制分别降低12.6%和5.8%的标准差。尽管青年生活研究的主要队列在执行功能测量时约为12岁，但对年轻兄弟姐妹可用数据的补充结果和分析表明，发育迟缓对执行功能——特别是工作记忆——的影响始于更早的年龄。我们的结果揭示了早期营养与学业成绩测试之间关系的机制，表明良好的营养是儿童学习能力的重要决定因素。

articles.title_en: The Politics of Extractivism: Mining, Institutional Responsiveness, and Social Resistance
articles.title_cn: 采掘主义的政治：矿业、制度回应性与社会抵抗
articles.abstract_en: Natural resource exploitation often generates negative externalities and fuels social conflict. Yet, patterns of social resistance against mining differ considerably within and across countries. What explains differences in the occurrence and duration of anti-mining protest? Distinguishing explicitly between protest onset and continuation, we theorize that communities affected by mining engage in social protest to signal their grievances to political decision-makers. Yet, once protests have erupted, their duration depends on the institutional setup that shapes these decision-makers’ likelihood of responding to grievances. Under conditions of high decentralized responsiveness, where regional governments have both the competences to enact policies and the electoral incentives to make use of them, regional governments are likely to rely on “policy side payments” in mining-unrelated domains to assuage mining-related grievances. Thus, decentralized responsiveness should reduce the duration of anti-mining protest. To test our argument, we introduce novel subnational data on mining activities and anti-mining protests in Bolivia, Peru, and Ecuador from 2002 to 2013. Using dynamic logit regression models, we find that the determinants of protest onset and continuation differ systematically. While the volume of mining activities impacts protest onset, the duration of anti-mining protests decreases significantly under conditions of high decentralized responsiveness. These results have implications for our understanding of governments’ ability to balance the economic benefits and social costs of natural resource exploitation, as well as for the interplay between institutionalized and non-institutionalized arenas of political contention.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然资源开发常常产生负面外部性并引发社会冲突。然而，不同国家内部及国家之间针对采矿的社会抵抗模式存在显著差异。是什么解释了反采矿抗议发生及持续时间的差异？我们明确区分抗议的起始与延续，提出理论认为受采矿影响的社区通过社会抗议向政治决策者传达其不满。然而，一旦抗议爆发，其持续时间取决于影响决策者回应不满可能性的制度安排。在高度分散化回应性的条件下，即地方政府既有制定政策的权限，又有利用这些权限的选举激励时，地方政府可能倾向于在采矿无关领域采取“政策补偿”来缓解与采矿相关的不满。因此，分散化回应性应能缩短反采矿抗议的持续时间。为检验我们的论点，我们引入了2002年至2013年玻利维亚、秘鲁和厄瓜多尔采矿活动与反采矿抗议的新颖次国家数据。使用动态logit回归模型，我们发现抗议起始与延续的决定因素系统性不同。采矿活动量影响抗议的起始，而高度分散化回应性条件下反采矿抗议的持续时间显著缩短。这些结果对我们理解政府在平衡自然资源开发的经济效益与社会成本方面的能力，以及制度化与非制度化政治抗争领域之间的相互作用具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Resilience – and collapse – of local food systems in conflict affected areas; reflections from Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 冲突影响地区当地食物系统的韧性与崩溃——来自布基纳法索的思考
articles.abstract_en: Armed conflicts are among the major disruptions affecting local food systems in low- and middle-income countries, having devastating effects on populations’ food security. The understanding of the mechanisms linking conflicts to food insecurity is limited, however, by a lack of data on how these conflicts affect the different actors of local food systems. In this study, we aim to address this gap, using empirical data from the northeast region of Burkina Faso where an active conflict is occurring. The objective is to document and analyze the impacts of that conflict on the functioning of the local food system and more specifically on the resilience of the traders that operate from Sebba, the capital of the Yagha province. The analysis reveals, first, the magnitude of the disruption. On average, these local food traders experienced a 40%-50% contraction in their activities compared to the situation prior to the conflict. Not all operators are affected with the same intensity, however. Transporters appeared to be impacted more severely than retailers/vendors. Econometric models are then used to explore the socio-economic characteristics of these different actors. The analysis shows that, contrarily to what is often observed with farmers, the level of assets did not seem to contribute significantly to traders’ resilience. Instead, having recently relocated to Sebba appears more important to ensure the level of adaptability needed to respond to the rapidly deteriorating situation. The analysis also reveals that the resilience of the “positive deviants” (those operators who did better than the rest of the group) materialized essentially through their capacity to buffer more effectively shocks’ impacts but it did not spare them from facing drastic contractions in their trade business. Eventually, the resilience of those positive deviants was not sufficient to maintain the resilience of the whole system. It ensues a catastrophic drop in the quantity of food traded (up to 50% for certain products), leading to the collapse of the system and a 10-fold increase in the food insecurity of the local population. The paper concludes by weighing the usefulness of the concept of resilience in the context of severe disruptions of the food systems (such as armed conflicts), emphasizes the risk that an unconditional promotion/adoption of that concept may reduce our ability to anticipate or even to envision collapse scenarios. On the brighter side, our analysis demonstrates that collecting specific information about the food system operators can help predict, and possibly prevent, such collapses.
articles.abstract_cn: 武装冲突是影响低收入和中等收入国家当地食物系统的主要干扰因素之一，对人口的粮食安全造成毁灭性影响。然而，由于缺乏关于冲突如何影响当地食物系统不同参与者的数据，对冲突与粮食不安全之间机制的理解受到限制。在本研究中，我们旨在利用布基纳法索东北部地区正在发生冲突的实证数据来弥补这一空白。目标是记录并分析该冲突对当地食物系统运作的影响，更具体地说，是对在亚加省首府塞巴运营的商贩韧性的影响。分析首先揭示了干扰的严重程度。平均而言，这些当地粮食商贩的活动与冲突前相比收缩了40%至-50%。然而，并非所有经营者都受到同等程度的影响。运输商似乎比零售商/摊贩受到的影响更为严重。随后使用计量经济学模型来探索这些不同参与者的社会经济特征。分析表明，与农民中经常观察到的情况相反，资产水平似乎并未对商贩的韧性做出显著贡献。相反，最近迁至塞巴似乎更能确保应对迅速恶化局势所需的适应能力。分析还揭示，“积极偏差者”（那些表现优于群体其他成员的经营者）的韧性主要通过其更有效地缓冲冲击影响的能力体现，但这并未使他们免于面临贸易业务的急剧收缩。最终，这些积极偏差者的韧性不足以维持整个系统的韧性。这导致交易粮食数量灾难性下降（某些产品下降高达50%），系统崩溃，当地人口粮食不安全状况增加了10倍。本文最后权衡了韧性概念在食物系统严重中断（如武装冲突）背景下的有用性，强调无条件推广/采纳该概念可能削弱我们预测甚至设想崩溃情景的能力。从积极方面看，我们的分析表明，收集关于食物系统运营者的具体信息有助于预测并可能防止此类崩溃。

articles.title_en: Reducing energy poverty by nearly universal pension coverage of rural China
articles.title_cn: 通过中国农村近乎全民养老金覆盖减少能源贫困
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal effect of income change on reducing energy poverty by exploiting age-based eligibility for China’s New Rural Pension Scheme (NRPS) through a regression discontinuity (RD) design. More than one billion people worldwide live in energy poverty, and the situation is even more difficult in developing world. It is an important development challenge to reduce energy poverty, which could be further associated with health outcome, labor productivity, and educational achievements. While public policies that increase income for poor households are the most direct ways to reduce energy poverty, the reverse causality makes establishing a convincing causal link between income and energy poverty challenging. Using the quasi-experimental variation in income induced by NRPS, this paper addresses the endogeneity of income and examines the impact of exogenous sharp changes in income on energy consumption behaviors. The findings indicate substantial increases in modern energy consumption and sizable reductions in solid fuels (e.g., straw and fuelwood), suggesting that “windfall income” by pension coverage alleviates energy poverty. Although individuals could anticipate the income shocks by pension coverage, the evidence suggests that they do not engage in anticipatory responses to smooth their consumption. Further evidence shows that liquidity constraints may be the underlying mechanism for the lack of anticipatory responses in household energy consumption. Besides reducing energy poverty, the results demonstrate that pension coverage leads to a decrease in elderly labor supply, an increase in subjective health and life satisfaction, and an increase in non-energy consumption, all of which are positively associated with the well-beings of senior citizens. We anticipate that the findings of this paper in the context of China may be extended to developing world which has been expected to set up targeted measures to tackle energy poverty in upcoming decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国新型农村社会养老保险（NRPS）的年龄资格，通过断点回归（RD）设计，估计了收入变化对减少能源贫困的因果效应。全球有超过十亿人生活在能源贫困中，发展中国家的情况更为严峻。减少能源贫困是一项重要的发展挑战，它可能进一步与健康结果、劳动生产率和教育成就相关联。虽然增加贫困家庭收入的公共政策是减少能源贫困的最直接方式，但反向因果使得建立收入与能源贫困之间令人信服的因果联系具有挑战性。利用NRPS引起的准实验性收入变化，本文解决了收入的内生性问题，并考察了外生收入急剧变化对能源消费行为的影响。研究结果表明，现代能源消费显著增加，固体燃料（如秸秆和薪柴）的使用大幅减少，这表明养老金覆盖带来的“意外之财”缓解了能源贫困。尽管个人可以预期养老金覆盖带来的收入冲击，但证据表明他们并未进行预期性反应以平滑消费。进一步证据显示，流动性约束可能是家庭能源消费缺乏预期性反应的潜在机制。除了减少能源贫困外，结果表明养老金覆盖还导致老年劳动力供给减少，主观健康和生活满意度提高，以及非能源消费增加，所有这些都与老年人的福祉正相关。我们预计，本文在中国背景下的研究结果可能推广到发展中国家，这些国家预计将在未来几十年内制定有针对性的措施来解决能源贫困问题。
